vehicle.name: 2019 Toyota Corolla Hatchback
vehicle.trim: Ascent Sport (halogen headlights, no parking sensors)

steps: Matched vehicle: 2019 Corolla Hatchback, Ascent Sport
Found lower grille and front bumper cover for this trim
Checked new vs used bumper options

lines.reason_long: The lower grille fits all trims and is under $150. Scrape damage at the front lower edge usually breaks it.

lines.reason_short: New or used bumper cover both fit this Corolla.
lines.reason_long: A new cover and a used grade A cover both fit the Ascent Sport. The used one is cheaper but cannot be returned.
lines.question: New or used front bumper cover?

lines.reason_short: Fresh clips needed to refit the bumper.
lines.reason_long: Clips often break when a bumper is removed. It depends on the bumper choice, so confirm it with one tap.

result.reply: Added the lower grille and suggested a clip kit; please pick a new or used bumper cover.
